name: Which flooring materials work best for foreclosed property rehabs?

mainEntity.name: Which flooring materials work best for foreclosed property rehabs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury vinyl plank and ceramic tile are usually the best choices for foreclosed property renovations. Foreclosed homes often carry moisture concerns, cosmetic neglect, or pet damage, requiring resilient materials. LVP offers a cost-effective, water-resistant surface that looks like hardwood and installs quickly throughout main living areas. For bathrooms, laundry rooms, and kitchens, durable tile provides a permanent, waterproof barrier. At HH Remodeling, our crew handles tile and marble work directly while managing full interior turnarounds, making LVP and tile the most durable balance between material price and long-term resale or rental appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury vinyl plank and tile offer the best balance of moisture resistance, durability, and cost for foreclosed homes being prepared for resale or rental.
